name: AMS Venera
about: AMS Venera (1961 GAM 1, OKB1), launched 1961 Feb 12. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.710 au and aphelion 1.015 au against GCAT's 0.718 and 1.019
